In canonical physical-time coordinates u=x-x*, v=-P(n-n_h)/omega, direct cubic sigmoid derivatives give f_uu=k/q, f_uv=tau-k*omega/q, f_vv=k*omega^2/q, f_uuu=(1-6q)/q^2, f_uvv=(1-6q)*omega^2/q^2-2k tau omega/q; g_uu=g_vv=g_uuv=g_vvv=0. Independently substituted into planar Hopf l1 formula; identity reduces to zero using k^2=1-4q and k*tau/omega=-chi. Exact witness theta=1/10,(r,s,p,t)=(2,1,31,1) gives chi=81/20, beta_h=(22+9 log 10)/21, epsilon*=30.0811031274275; computed l1=-4.4232132741 at epsilon=1 and +1.5086565361 at epsilon=40. The standard Hopf theorem supplies local cycle side/stability only when l1!=0; no global or generalized-Hopf claim.

final_claim: For the specified two-strategy logit/environment ODE with theta in (0,1), epsilon>0 and r>s>0,p,t>0, the physical-time first Lyapunov coefficient at interior Hopf is l1=-[(2+chi)+(2-chi)*omega^2]/(16q), chi=(1-theta)a/D>-2 and omega^2=epsilon*beta_h*q*D*n_h(1-n_h). For chi<=2 the nondegenerate Hopf is supercritical. For chi>2 it switches sign at epsilon*=(2+chi)/((chi-2)*beta_h*q*D*n_h(1-n_h)); epsilon=epsilon* is excluded from nondegenerate claims. The specified positive payoff game switches from attracting at epsilon=1 to repelling at epsilon=40.
